name: /pm2-status — PM2 process watchboard
goal: Add /pm2-status Telegram command (owner-only). Runs pm2 jlist, formats a compact process table showing name, status emoji, uptime, restarts for all PM2 processes. Operator can confirm all crons and daemons are running from Telegram without SSH.
rationale: Operator has no visibility into whether kognai-daily-digest, kognai-post-noon/evening, kognai-brief-regen, telegram-bot, achiri-api, etc. are actually running. Single /pm2-status call surfaces any crashed or stopped processes immediately.
swarm: NOT USED — 2 file edits (commands.ts + index.ts) + 1 validation script. Direct write.

tasks.title: commands.ts — add handlePm2Status()
tasks.description: Add handlePm2Status(chatId, ownerChatId): owner-only. execSync('pm2 jlist') → parse JSON array. For each process: name, pm2_env.status (online/stopped/errored), pm_uptime (format as Xh or Xd), restart_time. Build compact message: header '⚙️ PM2 Processes', then per-process line '🟢/🔴/🟡 name — status (uptime, R:N)'. Footer: total count + online count. Catch any execSync error (pm2 not found, etc.) and send error message.
